name: John Rutledge House
scope: The main John Rutledge House at 116 Broad Street in Charleston, as photographed in October 2019. Includes the three-story masonry exterior and two-story cast-iron street porch.

references.artist: Warren LeMay from Covington, KY, United States
references.filename: Iron Porch, Governor John Rutledge House, French Quarter, Charleston, SC (49432383372).jpg

originalReview.notes: The upward porch view shows two tiers of openwork cast-iron posts, brackets and balcony railings.

references.artist: Warren LeMay from Covington, KY, United States
references.filename: Iron Fence, Governor John Rutledge House, French Quarter, Charleston, SC (49432157096).jpg

originalReview.notes: The fence and entrance show the black-and-white tiled approach, raised stairs, fleur-de-lis caps and blue-green paint.

references.artist: Warren LeMay from Covington, KY, United States
references.filename: Governor John Rutledge House, French Quarter, Charleston, SC (49431677358).jpg

originalReview.notes: The oblique front and west side show the shallow hip, return walls, paired visible chimneys, sash and arched stone hoods.

references.artist: Warren LeMay from Covington, KY, United States
references.filename: Iron Porch Column, Governor John Rutledge House, French Quarter, Charleston, SC (49431678483).jpg

originalReview.notes: The detailed porch-column photograph shows the vine-like open cast pattern and narrow structural corners.

originalReview.notes: The front view establishes the five bays, three principal levels, cream wall, blue-green porch, flanking iron posts and small gable.
